task.name: Shut_down_flame_effects
task.when: At the end of flame-effect operation or when the Flame Lead orders normal shutdown

step.action: Keep the trained spotter and approved perimeter in place.
Close the effect-feed valve at 🔥 Zimmer_Vaporizer identified in the approved procedure.
Fire the approved final poof only when wind and the perimeter remain safe.
step.ifThen: IF a safe final poof is not possible, THEN use the approved emergency-shutdown sequence instead.

step.action: Wait until the effect flame and pilot are out.
Close every effect safety valve in the order printed in 🔥 Flame_Effect_Operating_Procedure.

passWhen.criterion: The effect feed and every effect safety valve are closed.
No effect flame or pilot remains lit.

reasoning.entry: The Post-event worker verifies the licensed Flame Lead's completed shutdown; an ordinary cleanup worker does not operate valves.
